hedge.capital_snapshot.panel.title: Capital Snapshot
hedge.capital_snapshot.panel.summary: Current state of the independent Hedge simulation strategy: capital, margin, PnL, exposure, capacity, and risk visibility.
details: Starting Capital is the configured Hedge account baseline.
Open Equity is the current Hedge account value including open LONG and SHORT basket PnL, before estimated exit fees.
If Closed Now subtracts estimated exit fees from current open equity.
Available Capital is open equity minus used Hedge margin.
Used Margin is Hedge capital currently tied to open basket entries.
Unrealized PnL is current open basket movement; Realized PnL is only from completed Hedge resets.
Total Fees combines recorded Hedge entry fees and reset/close fee effects currently known to the replay.
Peak Capital and Lowest Capital come from Hedge-owned account snapshots.
Entry Capacity shows whether the next standard Hedge entry can be opened and how many same-size entries fit into available capital.
Net Exposure shows the notional difference between LONG and SHORT baskets; FLAT can still mean both baskets are open but balanced.
Side Imbalance shows which side is larger by notional; BALANCED means LONG and SHORT notional are equal.
Margin Used, Worst Basket ROE, Danger Distance, and Liquidation Risk are first-pass visibility metrics, not exchange-grade liquidation modeling.
Accepted Hedge Entries are Futures OPENED events copied into Hedge; Skipped Hedge Entries are source events Hedge did not accept.

hedge.capital.open_equity.title: Open Equity
hedge.capital.open_equity.summary: Current Hedge account equity including open basket PnL, before estimated exit fees.
details: Formula: cash plus unrealized LONG and SHORT basket PnL.
Green means the value is above starting capital; red means below starting capital.
This is mark-to-market state, not a closed realized result.

hedge.capital.if_closed_now.title: If Closed Now
hedge.capital.if_closed_now.summary: Estimated Hedge equity if both baskets were closed at the current mark price.
details: Formula: Open Equity minus estimated exit fees.
This is only an estimate because slippage and funding fees are not modeled yet.
Use this to compare open mark-to-market value against close-after-fees value.

hedge.capital.entry_capacity.title: Entry Capacity
hedge.capital.entry_capacity.summary: Whether the Hedge account can open the next standard Hedge entry and approximately how many entries remain before capital exhaustion.
details: YES means available capital is enough for one more configured Hedge entry.
The LEFT count estimates how many same-size entries fit into available capital.
This does not force a reset by itself; reset happens when a new Hedge entry cannot be opened from Hedge capital.

hedge.capital.peak_lowest.title: Peak And Lowest Capital
hedge.capital.peak_lowest.summary: Highest and lowest Hedge equity recorded in Hedge-owned account history.
details: These values come from Hedge-owned account snapshots instead of frontend recalculation.
They do not depend on how many Futures candles are currently retained.
The chart uses full Hedge basket snapshot history when available and live equity timeline data as fallback.

hedge.capital.net_exposure.title: Net Exposure
hedge.capital.net_exposure.summary: The notional difference between the LONG and SHORT Hedge baskets.
details: FLAT means LONG notional and SHORT notional are equal.
LONG means the LONG basket is larger by notional.
SHORT means the SHORT basket is larger by notional.
This is not the same as no positions; balanced LONG and SHORT baskets can still have open PnL risk.

hedge.capital.side_imbalance.title: Side Imbalance
hedge.capital.side_imbalance.summary: Shows which basket is larger and by what ratio.
details: BALANCED means LONG and SHORT notional are equal.
SHORT 2.00x means the SHORT notional is twice the LONG notional.
This is visibility only; it does not block entries in the current Hedge rules.

hedge.capital.margin_used.title: Margin Used
hedge.capital.margin_used.summary: Used Hedge margin as a percentage of current open equity.
details: Formula: used margin divided by open equity.
Higher values mean more Hedge capital is tied in baskets.
It is a pressure metric, not a direct liquidation calculation.

hedge.capital.worst_basket_roe.title: Worst Basket ROE
hedge.capital.worst_basket_roe.summary: The weaker ROE value between the LONG and SHORT baskets.
details: ROE is unrealized PnL divided by that basket's used margin.
This helps identify which side is currently under pressure.
If both baskets are positive, worst basket ROE is capped at 0 for risk-label calculations.

hedge.capital.danger_distance.title: Danger Distance
hedge.capital.danger_distance.summary: How many percentage points remain before the first HIGH-risk threshold in the current simple risk label.
details: The current first-pass danger threshold is worst basket ROE at -80%.
A larger value is safer; a smaller value means the weakest basket is closer to the danger zone.
This is a visibility metric only, not an exchange liquidation-price model.

hedge.capital.liquidation_risk.title: Liquidation Risk
hedge.capital.liquidation_risk.summary: First-pass LOW / ELEVATED / MEDIUM / HIGH risk label based on worst basket ROE.
details: LOW means the weakest basket is not near the configured danger bands.
ELEVATED, MEDIUM, and HIGH are based on simple ROE thresholds.
This is not exchange-grade liquidation modeling and does not change Hedge entries or resets yet.

hedge.long_basket.panel.title: LONG Basket
hedge.long_basket.panel.summary: Aggregated Hedge LONG entries created from confirmed Futures LONG opened events.
details: Entries are accumulated into one virtual LONG basket.
Average entry is not a single trade entry; it is the weighted basket average.
Unrealized PnL and ROE are measured at the current mark price.

hedge.short_basket.panel.title: SHORT Basket
hedge.short_basket.panel.summary: Aggregated Hedge SHORT entries created from confirmed Futures SHORT opened events.
details: Entries are accumulated into one virtual SHORT basket.
Average entry is not a single trade entry; it is the weighted basket average.
Unrealized PnL improves when mark price moves below the average entry and worsens when mark price moves above it.

hedge.equity_chart.panel.title: Equity Δ% from Start
hedge.equity_chart.panel.summary: Hedge account equity movement measured against the configured starting capital.
details: The chart reads full Hedge basket snapshot history when available.
If basket snapshots are missing, it falls back to Hedge-owned equity timeline cycle snapshots.
0% is the configured Hedge starting capital baseline.
Green means Hedge equity is above starting capital; red means below starting capital.
This chart does not read Futures portfolio equity and does not use rendered page values.

hedge.entries.panel.title: Hedge Entries
hedge.entries.panel.summary: Accepted Hedge entries copied from confirmed Futures OPENED events into the independent Hedge account.
details: Each row has its own Hedge ID and source Futures position ID.
These entries ignore the original Futures TP/SL lifecycle after being copied.
The table defaults to the latest five entries and can show more rows from the selector.
